question: What new international body has Brazil proposed to accelerate global climate action?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**​Global Climate Council.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Brazil Proposes Global Climate Council Ahead of COP30.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
Brazil has proposed creating a new international body to accelerate global climate action.

 
 
• 
 
The proposal is shared ahead of COP30, set to be held in Belem, Brazil in November 2025.

 
 
• 
 
The new body would be called the **"****Global Climate Council****.**"

 
 
• 
 
The council would operate under the **United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC).**

 
 
• 
 
The primary goal of the council is to **fast-track decisions** made at COP meetings.

 
 
• 
 
The council would aim to **better coordinate international efforts** for climate action.
